body:
Hi,

When running `alpasim_wizard +deploy=local     wizard.log_dir=$PWD/tutorial     'scenes.scene_ids=["clipgt-a309e228-26e1-423e-a44c-cb00aa7378cb","clipgt-29815599-a5e2-4677-8144-f3d831bbd142"]' `with data from [nvidia/PhysicalAI-Autonomous-Vehicles-NuRec [26.02_release],](url) there seems to be a new Unknown calib name='free-pose-calib'. Will it be necessary for me to change anything in SensorSim docker build process to fit this?
